# GeoViz

GeoViz audits AI visibility for local businesses.

## What GeoViz does
- Checks how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini see a business website
- Provides an AI Visibility Score from 0 to 100
- Identifies the specific issues hurting AI recommendations
- Delivers a prioritized action plan in plain language

## Service offered
- AI Visibility Audit — $97 (early-customer pricing; normally $147)
- GEO Foundation Fix — $497 (done-for-you implementation of the audit fixes)

## Who it's for
Local service businesses: roofers, HVAC companies, contractors, lawyers,
dentists, med spas, real estate agents, and similar professionals who want
to be recommended when customers ask AI platforms for help.

## Where to start
- Sample report: https://geoviz.app/sample-report
- Order an audit: https://geoviz.app/order
